title: Students and youth wings of CPI(ML) Liberation protest in Patna against CEC
seoTitle: Patna protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar

tea.why: Protesters oppose the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and allege the CEC is acting on behalf of the central government.
tea.want: The resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 13: Police detained several protesters after scuffles broke out at the Dak Bungalow roundabout.

summary: On October 13, 2026, activists from the All India Students' Association (AISA) and the Revolutionary Youth Association (RYA), the student and youth wings of the CPI(ML) Liberation, held a protest march in Patna. The demonstrators marched from Gandhi Maidan toward Lok Bhavan to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing concerns over the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Police intercepted the march at J P Golambar and later at the Dak Bungalow roundabout, where scuffles occurred after some participants breached barricades. The Patna district administration stated that all demonstrations must be held at the designated site in Gardanibagh and warned of legal action against protests in unauthorized locations. Several protesters were detained by police during the event.
demands: Review of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
response: The Patna district administration issued a statement directing all protests to the designated site at Gardanibagh, citing concerns over traffic disruption and public inconvenience. Police detained several protesters during the march.

arrests.text: Police detained two dozen protesters according to Hindustan Times.

updates.text: Protest march begins at Gandhi Maidan and is stopped by police at J P Golambar.
Protesters breach barricades and move toward Dak Bungalow roundabout, leading to police detentions and scuffles.
